note: The rails that keep an agent-written note static text: no code a plugin runs, no view that renders other notes live, no link that acts, nothing fetched from outside the vault. A new rail is a row here, never a code branch.

fence_known.dataviewjs: Dataview JavaScript, which runs with the plugin's file and network access
fence_known.dataview: a Dataview query, which renders other notes live
fence_known.query: an embedded search, which renders other notes live
fence_known.base: an embedded Bases view, which renders and edits other notes' properties
fence_known.tasks: a Tasks query, which renders other notes live
fence_known.button: a Buttons block, which runs commands

fence_prefixes.run-: an Execute Code block, which shows a run button in the preview
